full_target:
Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
\(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy

\[
[h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
\]

Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
\(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
\(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
\(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.

Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
\(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
algebraically closed.

lean_header:
import Mathlib

namespace YuiBasisObjects

noncomputable def dividedPower {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r

def Stable {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (W : Submodule K V) (f : Module.End K V) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, w ∈ W → f w ∈ W

structure AdmissibleLattice (n : ℕ) (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) where
  carrier : Submodule ℤ V
  zBasis : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ carrier
  cBasis : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℂ V
  coe_basis : ∀ i, (zBasis i : V) = cBasis i
  stableX : ∀ (r : ℕ) (m : V), m ∈ carrier → dividedPower x r m ∈ carrier
  stableY : ∀ (r : ℕ) (m : V), m ∈ carrier → dividedPower y r m ∈ carrier

end YuiBasisObjects

dependencies.statement: For any field F, finite-dimensional F-vector space U, finite index type I, and linearly independent family b:I→U, if |I|=dim_F U, then span_F{b_i:i∈I}=U.

origin.revision: stage-pinned Mathlib (the environment used by read_mathlib and the native basis check)

lean.type: ∀ (F U I : Type*) [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U] [Fintype I] [FiniteDimensional F U] (b : I → U), LinearIndependent F b → Fintype.card I = Module.finrank F U → Submodule.span F (Set.range b) = ⊤
lean.proof:
intro F U I _ _ _ _ _ b hb hc
exact hb.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' hc

dependencies.justification: Direct application of the named declaration(s) in the pinned Mathlib, with all parameters and typeclasses bound in the displayed proposition. No additional axiom or task hypothesis is introduced.

dependencies.statement: For every field K, abelian group M regarded as a Z-module, natural n and Z-basis b indexed by Fin n, K⊗_Z M has a K-basis c indexed by Fin n with c_i=1⊗b_i, and dim_K(K⊗_Z M)=n.

origin.revision: stage-pinned Mathlib (the environment used by read_mathlib and the native basis check)

lean.type: ∀ (K M : Type*) [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M] (n : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ M), ∃ c : Module.Basis (Fin n) K (TensorProduct ℤ K M), (∀ i, c i = TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (1 : K) (b i)) ∧ Module.finrank K (TensorProduct ℤ K M) = n
lean.proof:
intro K M _ _ _ n b
refine ⟨b.baseChange K, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro i
  simp
· simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (b.baseChange K)

dependencies.statement: For any field F, F-vector space U, finite index type I and basis b:I→U, every u is the sum of its coordinate multiples of b_i, and two F-linear endomorphisms agreeing on all b_i are equal.

origin.revision: stage-pinned Mathlib (the environment used by read_mathlib and the native basis check)

lean.type: ∀ (F U I : Type*) [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U] [Fintype I] (b : Module.Basis I F U), (∀ u, ∑ i, b.repr u i • b i = u) ∧ (∀ f g : Module.End F U, (∀ i, f (b i) = g (b i)) → f = g)
lean.proof:
intro F U I _ _ _ _ b
refine ⟨b.sum_repr, ?_⟩
intro f g h
exact b.ext h
